description: This PHP source file defines the UserPreference class, which manages user preferences in the SuiteCRM system. It includes methods for getting, setting, loading, reloading, saving, and resetting preferences, as well as updating preferences across all users. The class interacts with the database to persist user preferences and supports session-based caching.

classes.name: UserPreference
classes.description: Class to handle user preference management, including CRUD operations, loading, reloading, and resetting preferences in the SuiteCRM environment.

methods.name: getPreference
methods.description: Retrieves a preference value by name and category for the user, supports lazy loading and default preferences.

methods.name: getDefaultPreference
methods.description: Provides default preference value from system configuration if not set for user.

methods.name: setPreference
methods.description: Sets a preference value for the user in session, marking it for database persistence.

methods.name: loadPreferences
methods.description: Loads preferences from the database for a specified category, caching in session.

methods.name: reloadPreferences
methods.description: Forcibly reloads user preferences from the database, updating session cache.

methods.name: getUserDateTimePreferences
methods.description: Retrieves user's date and time format preferences, including timezone info.

methods.name: savePreferencesToDB
methods.description: Persists all session-stored preferences into the database.

methods.name: resetPreferences
methods.description: Resets preferences for a user; optionally for a specific category, clearing database entries and session data.

methods.name: updateAllUserPrefs
methods.description: Admin function to mass-update user preferences with a new key-value pair, supporting nested updates.
